# COR031 `procedure-not-in-module`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A subroutine or function is defined outside a module (an external procedure).

## Why

External procedures have implicit interfaces at every call site that does not repeat an interface
block, so argument mismatches go undetected. Module procedures get explicit interfaces for free.

## Reported

```fortran
subroutine helper(x)
  ...
end subroutine helper
```

## Preferred

```fortran
module helpers
contains
  subroutine helper(x)
    ...
  end subroutine helper
end module helpers
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR031] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR031` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C092` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
